newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.88 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.88 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed unchanged at 14.88 ringgit ($5.94) a kg after being unaffected by Friday's fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME).
"Both buyers and sellers came on strong at the opening of the market and matched positions," said a trader. "The market was very steady and was not affected by the LME."
Turnover rose to 79 tonnes from 74 tonnes on Friday. Dealers said the local price fetched a premium of $15 against the LME, compared to Friday when it was at par.
